releases.notes:
## Waystones Squaremap Addon v1.0.0

First public release! 🎉

### Features
- Interactive squaremap-style terrain view in the Waystones menu
- Persistent tile caching per server and dimension
- Dimension switching and filtering (Overworld/Nether/End)
- Favorites system with drag-and-drop reordering
- Party member markers (requires Open Parties and Claims)
- Automatic map centering on waystone selection

### Installation
Download the JAR file below and place it in your .minecraft/mods folder.

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader
- Waystones mod (Fabric)

Inspired by [squaremap](https://github.com/jpenilla/squaremap) by jpenilla.
